en.headline: HSBC plans AI and emerging technology institute in Northern Metropolis
en.dek: The bank aims to open the centre in the first quarter of 2027 with HKUST as anchor partner, later relocating it to the Northern Metropolis.
body: HSBC said it plans to establish an artificial intelligence and emerging technology institute in Hong Kong, with operations expected to begin in the first quarter of 2027.

Chief Executive Georges Elhedery announced the plan at Hong Kong FinTech Week. The institute will partner with the Hong Kong University of Science and Technology as its anchor academic partner and will focus initially on talent upskilling, AI safety and fraud detection, post-quantum cryptography and blockchain.

HSBC intends to move the institute to the Northern Metropolis once a suitable site is ready. The bank said the move reflects its long-term commitment to Hong Kong’s development as an international innovation and technology centre.

The institute will combine research with application teams to turn promising ideas into practical capabilities across the bank’s businesses. HSBC is also rolling out AI training to its global workforce of roughly 200,000 people.

zh.headline: 滙豐計劃在北部都會區成立人工智能研究院
zh.dek: 銀行擬於2027年首季投入運作，以香港科技大學為主要學術夥伴，並於場地就緒後遷往北都。
body: 滙豐表示，計劃在香港成立人工智能及新興科技研究院，預計2027年第一季投入運作。
行政總裁艾橋智在香港金融科技周公布計劃。研究院將以香港科技大學為主要學術夥伴，初期聚焦人才技能提升、人工智能安全及詐騙偵測、後量子密碼學及區塊鏈等領域。
滙豐打算在北部都會區場地準備就緒後，將研究院遷往該處。銀行表示，此舉體現對香港長遠發展的承諾，支持本港成為國際創新科技中心。
研究院將結合研究與應用團隊，把有潛力的方案轉化為可在集團各項業務應用的能力。滙豐亦正為全球約20萬名員工推行人工智能培訓。
